title: Floral Shoppe cover art
lede: Macintosh Plus’s album art: a Helios bust on a pink-and-black checkered floor beside a video still of the Twin Towers, with the title in green katakana.
summary: Helios bust, pink checkered floor, Twin Towers video still, green Japanese title. The genre’s template, 2011.

creator.name: Macintosh Plus (Ramona Langley, also known as Vektroid)

made: December 9, 2011 (digital release); 2012 cassette on Beer on the Rug

evidence.note: Inspected the 1200 × 1180 front J-card scan of the 2012 Beer on the Rug cassette (catalogue BOTR009) in the [Cover Art Archive](https://musicbrainz.org/release/165a3396-c023-42f5-a1fb-174b262ef862/cover-art), in a scratchpad copy. Compared it with the 600 × 600 cover of the 2011 digital release in the same archive and with the current 1200 × 1200 Bandcamp art, a later variant in which the bust has no face and a compact-disc frame surrounds the image. Not stored.

styles.note: Wikipedia calls it the first album “properly considered of the genre” and its cover the image most associated with vaporwave: classical bust, pastel pink, checkered floor, Japanese text, and pre-2001 media.

context: Released digitally on December 9, 2011, by Beer on the Rug. Wikipedia says it “established a blueprint for the genre” and that some albums, “including Floral Shoppe, depict the intact Twin Towers on their covers.” [Wikipedia: Floral Shoppe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Floral_Shoppe); [Wikipedia: Vaporwave](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vaporwave).

The bust is a Roman copy of the head of Helios, which is itself public domain; the cover as a whole is a copyrighted composition. [Wikipedia: Helios (statue)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helios_(statue)).
observed: A cut-out marble head on a white plinth fills the left half of the square.
The background is flat salmon pink; a black-and-pink checkered floor recedes to a horizon at the lower right.
A blurred, orange-and-violet video still shows a city skyline with the Twin Towers over water.
The title is set in mint-green katakana and Latin capitals (MACプラス, フローラルの専門店) beside a green isometric cube icon and a green rule.
On the cassette card a Sega Saturn manual header and “compact disc 取扱説明書” sit at the top, and the spine runs a full rainbow gradient.
interpretation: Every later cliché is already here: statue, pink, checkerboard, Japanese title, degraded video, and a quoted consumer-electronics label. The composition is sparse and flat, closer to a desktop collage than a designed sleeve.
borrow: Pair one cut-out object with one degraded video frame on a flat pastel ground, and add a perspective checkerboard in the lower third.

rights.statement: Copyrighted album art. No image is stored here.
